## Reported

Alphabet has agreed to invest up to $40bn in Anthropic [r_goog_anth]: $10bn in cash at a $350bn valuation plus up to $30bn tied to milestones [r_goog_anth]. In the other direction, Anthropic has committed $200bn to Alphabet's cloud over five years [r_anth_goog], but that figure rests on one weak source and carries low confidence.

The two are different bases (an "up to" investment against a committed spend), so they are not netted here. This assistant is built by Anthropic.

## What would change this view

- A filed figure for the $200bn commitment, for example in an Anthropic prospectus [r_anth_goog].
- Alphabet disclosing how much of the $30bn milestone tranche has been paid [r_goog_anth].
